d:
Anant sinh ki beti shivangi ki vidaee ke dauran mahaul bhavuk ho gaya. beti ko vida karte vakt chhote sarkar apne aansu nahin rok pae.
Shivangi ki vidaee ka yah vidiyo soshal midiya par samne aaya hai, jise dekhkar log bhi bhavuk ho rahe hain. dekhie anant sinh aur unki beti shivangi ki vidaee ka yah bhavuk pal.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
